data.title: Ethereum could reach $8,600 if it breaks $5,000... | Pluang
data.description: Analyst Peter Brandt forecasts Ethereum could rise to $8,600 if it first breaks the $5,000 resistance level. Currently trading around $2,660, Ethereum must overcome intermediate resistances at $3,000 and $5,000 before reaching the long-term target. This scenario is based on technical chart analysis without a specific timeline or guarantee. Meanwhile, Ethereum ETFs and companies like BitMine are increasing their holdings, supporting demand but not assuring the price target.
data.author: Cointribune
